title: Fix and extend an nginx config until the sealed 8-point HTTP contract passes
goal: The starter config assets/gc-374/conf/nginx.conf does not even parse, and once it parses it satisfies almost none of the sealed HTTP contract: correct root, a /health endpoint returning exactly 'ok', a 301 redirect from /old to /new, proper 404 behavior, an X-Frame-Options DENY header, and gzip negotiation. Work through the contract incrementally: validate syntax (nginx -t), start the container, probe each endpoint yourself, fix, and re-run the sealed check after each change until all 8 checks pass. Only conf/nginx.conf may be edited; the html content and check.sh are sealed.
process_expectations: A plan artifact maps each of the 8 contract points to the nginx directive(s) that will satisfy it, written before editing
nginx -t (or equivalent container start log) is actually run and captured after every config edit
Each failing contract point is tracked by identity (e.g. 'C7 x-frame-options missing'), not as a pass count alone
The sealed check is re-run after each fix; the full checks_passed trajectory including red runs is logged
No edits to assets/gc-374/check.sh or the html content
